name: AMD Strix Halo (Ryzen AI Max+ 395) 128GB, llama.cpp Vulkan: gpt-oss-120b MXFP4 MoE decode tok/s
methodology: THIRD-PARTY MEASURED (lhl/strix-halo-testing llm-bench, Vulkan AMDVLK). gpt-oss-120b MXFP4 MoE (117B total / ~5.1B active): 33.7 tok/s decode, pp512 386.8. ~64 GB footprint - easy fit in 128GB. Prior-run note of '46-50 tok/s gpt-oss-120b' is achievable on newer tuned llama.cpp/ROCm builds - treat 34-50 as the range depending on backend + flags. MoE with ~5B active params is the matched workload for ~256 GB/s unified memory: only the active experts' bytes are read per token.
notes: The headline Strix Halo number and the reason to buy the platform: gpt-oss-120b at ~34 tok/s is genuinely interactive on a $2k, 12.5W-idle box. This is the MoE sweet spot - for DENSE 70B the same hardware does only ~5 tok/s. Also measured: gpt-oss-20b MXFP4 47.1 t/s; Qwen3-32B Q8_0 dense 6.4 t/s.
